prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: side impact at intersection. Injury: shoulder injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1434; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE] at a signalized intersection. Our client was proceeding through the intersection on a green light when your insured failed to yield and struck the driver's side of our client's vehicle. The police report documents the point of impact and the resulting damage, and the available evidence places fault squarely on your insured.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a significant injury to the right shoulder. Diagnostic imaging confirmed the injury, and our client has undergone a course of physical therapy and continues to experience pain, reduced range of motion, and limitations in daily activities and work duties. Medical providers have indicated that further treatment may be necessary.

Liability in this matter is clear, and the damages are well documented through medical records, billing statements, and wage loss information, all of which we are prepared to provide upon request. Our client has made good-faith efforts to resolve this claim without litigation.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to settle all claims arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under law.
